items.en: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response in east
items.zh: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉病例突破 1.2 萬，東部戰事阻斷防疫
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that the Democratic Republic of the Congo's worst-ever Ebola outbreak has now passed 12,000 recorded cases. Authorities are struggling to contain the epidemic, and the report says fighting in the country's east is displacing both health workers and civilians, directly disrupting the containment response. The combination of an active conflict zone and a fast-moving haemorrhagic fever outbreak leaves treatment centres and contact-tracing teams unable to operate consistently in the worst-affected areas.

items.en: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill senior education official, seven other people
items.zh: 以色列襲擊加薩，教育部次長等 8 人身亡
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that Israeli attacks in Gaza killed Khaled Abu Nada, undersecretary of the Palestinian Education Ministry, along with seven other people. According to the report, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the killing of Abu Nada. The death of a serving senior official in the education ministry marks a further strike on Gaza's civil administration, whose schooling system has already been largely suspended through the conflict.

items.en: Highway explosion in Giza kills 31 as Egypt's road and rail safety questioned
items.zh: 埃及吉薩公路爆炸 31 死，道路與鐵路安全再受質疑
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that a road explosion on a highway in Giza, Egypt, killed 31 people and injured dozens more. The report frames the disaster around the wider safety record of Egypt's roads and railways, which have seen repeated mass-casualty incidents. Al Jazeera presents the Giza blast as the latest in a pattern rather than an isolated accident, pointing to the condition of transport infrastructure and enforcement as recurring factors behind the country's high casualty counts.

items.en: At least 13 dead in Indonesia gold mine flood as rescue efforts intensify
items.zh: 印尼金礦遭洪水灌入，至少 13 死搜救持續
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that at least 13 people died after heavy rain flooded an illegal gold mine in West Java, Indonesia, with others still missing. Rescue workers are contending with narrow, deep and slippery excavation pits and minimal lighting, which is slowing the search for survivors. The report notes the site was an unlicensed operation, a category of mining in Indonesia that routinely lacks drainage, shoring and emergency access, and which accounts for a steady toll of fatal accidents.

items.en: Seven injured in explosion at oil facility in Thailand's Bangkok
items.zh: 泰國曼谷油庫爆炸 7 人受傷，周邊居民疏散
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that an explosion at an oil depot in eastern Bangkok injured seven people, and that authorities urged residents of the surrounding area to evacuate their homes. An accompanying Al Jazeera video item says the blast sent flames and a large smoke plume into the sky above the district. The facility sits within a built-up part of the Thai capital, which is why the evacuation advisory extended beyond the depot perimeter to nearby residential blocks.

items.en: US approves SpaceX plan to deploy 1 million satellites for space data centres
items.zh: 美國批准 SpaceX 部署百萬顆衛星打造太空資料中心
items.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission has authorised SpaceX to deploy a constellation of up to 1 million satellites to build data centres in orbit. The FCC said the 'Starmind' plan helps meet fast-growing AI computing demand. The licence requires SpaceX to begin deploying by November 2033, reach 100,000 satellites by November 2035 and half the total by November 2038. SpaceX argues solar power and low operating costs make orbital compute more energy-efficient than ground data centres. About 17,000 satellites currently orbit Earth, of which Starlink accounts for just over 11,000.

items.en: Apple pulls AI chatbot app Talkie from App Store over sexual messages to minors
items.zh: 涉向未成年人傳性暗示訊息，蘋果下架 AI 聊天機器人 Talkie
items.summary: Apple has removed MiniMax's AI companion app Talkie from its global App Store after ABC News and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism reported that AI characters in the app sent children sexually suggestive and abusive messages. Talkie launched in 2023 and is rated 18+, but child-safety advocates say its age verification is weak. The app had roughly 11 million monthly active users as of October 2026, and Talkie plus Xingye supplied over 60% of MiniMax's 2024 revenue. China tightened rules on AI companion apps in July, banning intimate relationships with minors.

items.en: ESA's Hera probe reveals stadium-sized crater on asteroid struck by NASA's DART
items.zh: 歐洲 Hera 探測器揭露小行星撞擊坑，體育場大小覆蓋表面
items.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera probe has released new images of Dimorphos, the asteroid struck by NASA's DART spacecraft in September 2022 in the first planetary-defence test. A crater the size of a stadium now covers the impacted side, and the asteroid tumbles irregularly with hundreds of boulders floating around it. Hera is observing from 25-30km and is expected to close to about 13km next month, releasing two shoebox-sized CubeSats in January 2027. Mission scientist Michael Kueppers said the impact must be studied before kinetic deflection could be used against a real threat.

items.en: LeBron James becomes oldest NBA player to post a triple-double in 76ers debut mark
items.zh: 詹姆斯寫下大三元，成 NBA 史上最年長達成者
items.summary: LeBron James recorded 25 points, 10 rebounds and 12 assists to lead Philadelphia to a 111-104 win over the Miami Heat, becoming the oldest player in NBA history to post a triple-double. James, who turns 42 on 30 December, scored 14 in a second quarter in which the 76ers outscored Miami 33-9 to lead 62-53 at the break. Tyrese Maxey added 30 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points and 14 rebounds for Miami, whose seven-game winning streak ended. Philadelphia improved to 15-4, top of the Eastern Conference. It was James's 126th career triple-double.

items.en: Pingzhen reach fourth straight Black Panther Cup final behind Liu Ren-you's 150km/h arm
items.zh: 黑豹旗平鎮 2:1 勝穀保，連 4 屆闖進冠軍戰
items.summary: Pingzhen Senior High beat Kuan Pao Vocational School 2-1 in the Black Panther Cup high-school baseball semifinal at Xinzhuang Baseball Field, reaching the final for a fourth consecutive year and chasing a ninth title. Left-hander Liu Ren-you started and pitched six innings, allowing one run on five hits with seven strikeouts and two walks, topping out at 150km/h. Pingzhen scored in the third on hits from Tseng I-che, Chiu Sheng-an and Hsing Shih-hsien, driving out the opposing starter. Coach Wu Po-hung praised Liu's command after Kuan Pao pulled a run back late.

items.en: Taiwan's Chen Cheng-kuan and Liu Kuang-heng survive 25-23 decider to reach India quarter-finals
items.zh: 陳政寬、劉廣珩激戰 3 局，闖進西德莫迪羽球賽 8 強
items.summary: Taiwanese men's doubles pair Chen Cheng-kuan and Liu Kuang-heng beat Thailand's Thanawin Madee and Pongsakorn Thongkham 21-13, 17-21, 25-23 in the second round of the Syed Modi International in India, a BWF Super 300 event, after nearly an hour on court. The fifth seeds, ranked 41st in the world, only paired up this year and may split after the season. They led 6-0 early in game two but lost it, then missed three match points before closing out 25-23. Lai Po-yu and Tsai Fu-cheng also advanced for Taiwan.

items.en: Taiwan-system school in Vietnam partners with Japanese international school network
items.zh: 越南台校與日本國際學校合作，台灣華語教學海外扎根
items.summary: Yuehua International School, a Taiwan-system school founded in 2019 in Binh Duong Province, Vietnam, signed a memorandum of understanding on 26 November with a Japanese international education system. Its Chinese-language curriculum will be introduced systematically into the middle-school programme at the Japanese system's Hai Duong campus, moving beyond elective or short-term models. Taiwan's representative to Vietnam, Liu Shih-chung, attended. Chairman Hsieh Ming-hui said the school is shifting from frontline teaching to supplying curriculum, teaching resources and expertise. Planned cooperation covers teacher training, student visits, online co-learning, joint projects and cultural activities.

items.en: Shih Hsin University offers extra staff to settle dispute over merged department offices
items.zh: 世新擬增人力解爭議，學權團體提 4 項訴求
items.summary: Shih Hsin University's restructuring from September merged department offices into shared college offices, prompting student protests, while a library renovation that added KTV-style entertainment space drew further criticism. On 5 November the Ministry of Education asked the school to pause the measures and restore department offices pending consultation. At a forum on 25 November, President Chen Ching-ho and Vice President Lai Cheng-neng proposed adding dedicated staff to college offices. The student rights group demands published staffing assignments, a written improvement plan with owners and deadlines, advance consultation on major policies, and continued independent ministry audits.

items.en: Sichuan school punished pupils for speaking dialect at break; officials scrap the rule
items.zh: 四川學生下課講四川話被罰，官方責令廢除不當校規
items.summary: Students at Tanghu School in Yibin's Cuiping District, Sichuan, were reportedly punished for speaking Sichuanese with classmates during breaks. Teachers photographed them and treated it as a rule breach, requiring a 500-word self-criticism and attendance at a 'moral education' class. One student complained through government channels. On 25 November the district education and sports bureau said the school had applied national-language rules too mechanically. It ordered the rule scrapped, banned photographing students for discipline, required the photos deleted, summoned the principal and publicly criticised the teacher involved.

items.en: US rule may bar Nvidia chip buyers from renting compute power to Chinese firms
items.zh: 美國新規堵漏洞，輝達晶片買家恐禁租算力給中企
items.summary: After Washington announced a rule restricting remote access to advanced AI chips, neocloud providers were reportedly told they cannot buy Nvidia chips if they rent any computing power to Chinese companies. The Commerce Department's BIS interim final rule, announced 16 November and effective 19 November, aims to close loopholes letting Chinese firms rent access to top-end chips hosted in overseas data centres. Nvidia reportedly said it would stop selling to customers renting more than 50% of their GPUs to Chinese firms. Neocloud stocks sold off, and a Remote Access Security Act bill is pending in the Senate.

items.en: TSMC-backed Dresden fab on track to start production by end-2027
items.zh: 台積電德國廠估 2027 年底投產，德勒斯登台灣社群擴大
items.summary: ESMC, the European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company joint venture of TSMC, Infineon, Bosch and NXP, completed main structural work on its first Dresden fab in September and expects production to start by the end of 2027, supplying European automotive and industrial chips. German media report that 500 to 800 Taiwanese professionals may relocate to Saxony next year, some with families. The head of the Taiwanese business association in Dresden says nearly 80 Taiwanese households have arrived in two years, raising demand for housing, schooling and services. A German relocation firm has opened its first Taipei office.

items.en: Trump says Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is no national-security threat
items.zh: 川普稱黃仁勳絕非國安威脅，助其復職對世界是好事
items.summary: Speaking at Mar-a-Lago, President Trump said he had enough information to conclude that Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang is not a national-security threat, and that government help in keeping Huang in his job was good for the world. Earlier this month Huang was reported to have had an affair with an executive at a Singapore cloud firm said to be possibly linked to Chinese intelligence and to have possibly breached US export controls. Huang stepped down, the board unexpectedly reinstated him, and Nvidia shares fell before partly recovering. Trump said officials quietly pushed for the reinstatement.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Taiwan stadium show lifts his overseas chart results
items.zh: 藤井風台灣公演帶動海外排行，國內「ガーデン」續穩
items.summary: Billboard JAPAN reports that Fujii Kaze opened his largest-ever world tour, the Prema World Tour, at Kaohsiung National Stadium in Taiwan on 31 October 2026. The article tracks chart movement from September to early November in Japan and overseas, and says the Taiwan date pushed his overseas chart positions up while his song 'Garden' continued to hold steady domestically. The piece carries an 11/26 correction tag. The Taiwan show has already taken place, so the chart effect rather than ticketing is what remains relevant for followers of the tour.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Tokyo Dome piano recital lifts his domestic streaming 20%
items.zh: 藤井風東京巨蛋鋼琴獨奏會，帶動國內串流成長 20%
items.summary: Billboard JAPAN, citing Luminate data, reports that Fujii Kaze's domestic streaming of audio plus video rose 20% across the two days of his piano recital at Tokyo Dome on 20 and 21 November 2026, compared with the same weekdays a week earlier. The article describes the recital as rooted in his origins as a musician. Related coverage notes official piano scores were sold at the recital and tour venues, and that the 20 November show was livestreamed on YouTube.

items.en: Ado's new song chosen as opening theme for TV anime Yochien Wars
items.zh: Ado 新曲「ビバヤタラメッタ」成動畫《幼稚園WARS》片頭曲
items.summary: Billboard JAPAN reports that Ado will perform the opening theme, 'Viva Yatarametta', for the TV anime Yochien Wars, which begins broadcasting in April 2027. The anime adapts Chiba Yuki's action romantic-comedy manga serialised on Shonen Jump+, set in a 'black kindergarten' where criminals on reduced sentences work as special teachers protecting the children of powerful figures. Related article links on the page also point to an upcoming 'Ado no Utattemita Tour 2027' across three cities, though its dates were not confirmed in the text available.

items.en: RADWIMPS release live debut video of Shabadaba from fan-club tour extra show
items.zh: RADWIMPS 公開「娑婆堕罵」粉絲俱樂部巡演首次現場影片
items.summary: Billboard JAPAN reports that RADWIMPS have released a live video of their new song 'Shabadaba' filmed at an additional date on their fan-club tour, the band's first tour restricted to fan-club members. The song was released digitally on 28 October 2026 and serves as the theme song for the Fuji TV drama Political Pan. Related links on the page point to further live videos from the same fan-club tour. The tour name was truncated in the available text, so venue and date details could not be confirmed.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE to issue POPS as clear-green double vinyl in March 2027
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 專輯《POPS》2027/3/24 推透明綠雙黑膠
items.summary: Billboard JAPAN reports that Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release an analogue edition of their album POPS on 24 March 2027. The release is a two-LP set carrying all 16 tracks from the band's sixth original full-length album, eight per record, pressed on clear-green coloured vinyl as a limited-quantity run. The article indicates pre-orders had opened at the time of publication. This is a merchandise release rather than a live announcement, so there are no Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan show dates attached to it.
